boundary: H2 spec plant: packed lift slope = 0.58·finsLatAccel·η_q/finsAoa, linear in η_q with no elbow or saturation observed from η=0.55 to 1.7 (three-flight PL-12 fast/slow-launch + R-77 replay joint fit 2026-08, 59 frames, R²=0.97–0.998, thrust-lateral component T·sinα/(m·g) removed from the displayed G before fitting); loadFactorMax is retained only as an untested F_N output cap, not a slope elbow; I=m L^2/12, I ω̇ = K(δ-α)-Cω with K=N'Δ, C=2√(KI), ζ=1. Default autopilot is datamine accelControl PID → fin angle (v12) with error in g (pid_error_scale=1). pid_error_units=mps2 was tested and rejected: ×g0 makes a bang-bang relay and a ~5 Hz G limit cycle; faster actuators made it worse and 4× smaller dt did not change it. timeToHitGain t_go = R/max(Vc, |V_rel|) so beam shots cannot inflate t_go. The shared G-outer/rate-inner cascade remains an opt-in candidate. CdA0 = S_w·CxK·C_et(M) interpolated 1943-law*1.10, CdA_α = S_d·CxAoA·min(α,1.2)^2 with S_d=πd²/4 and no Mach shape, optional CdA_δ default 0; missing baseIndSpeed uses shared 1800 km/h, η_q capped at 4; reqAccelMax caps the gravity-compensated specific-force command. Midcourse PIP lead-turn (IOG+DL→TRK launch heading catch-up) is a declared candidate absent from the datamine; τ_turn=0.8 s (fit within the declared 0.3-0.8 s range to the PL-12 30° slow-launch replay; lock_delay_s=0.8, blend_time_s=0.5 kept at the declared default) and the term self-fades as heading error closes. Not an end-to-end validation or game-solver reproduction.
